# Handshake fixtures

These are synthetic protocol messages, generated by
`node scripts/generate-handshake-fixtures.cjs` using the retained upstream
`common.js` `ShortToStr` / `IntToStr` helpers. This independently checks network
byte order, fixed offsets, unsigned 32-bit values, and UTF-8 name byte lengths.

Reference baseline: Ylianst/MeshCentral commit
`c897d5e539abe054b00b20674e2a7981d5181a50` (`meshagent.js`, commands 1–5 and 30).

The certificate-proof fixture contains **invalid placeholder certificate and
signature bytes**. It tests frame boundaries only. No fixture proves cryptographic
authentication, a live handshake, or interoperability with an actual agent.
